text: I took the electric bike yesterday. We went by the riverside. The weather was gray. The bike is not a motorcycle. It hums and it does not roar. It is like a friend. It is patient. The traffic lights are like small moons. The trucks are like planets. It is a little bit like the solar system. But I am still pedaling. The bike helps me, but it does not do all the work. It just gives me a hand. And it is a lot more pleasant. I used to ride by bike. But the hills were like arguments. I used to lose. But now it is more like a conversation. You know, it helps me on the hill. And then I reach the bridge. And it started raining. And I was very dry. And I thought, this is interesting. And the day feels very different. The hurry is gone. I just ride. And I arrive at work. And I feel very good. The wind is in my ears. And there is no pain in my chest. It is just calm. Very bright and calm. And then I ride back. And the lights are like dandelions. And I see something. And I think, I do not need to be in a car. I can ride the city. The city is a mosaic. And I ride through it. I do not watch it from inside. And it is nice. The bike does not make the effort disappear. But it makes it different. And I like it. And I am not trying to run away from the city. I am just meeting the city.
